name: MultiSim
description: A multilingual text simplification benchmark containing over 1.7 million complex-simple sentence pairs across 12 languages, designed to encourage research in multilingual text simplification models and evaluation metrics.
reputation: A substantial multilingual text simplification benchmark that is widely useful for cross-lingual simplification research, though it is less established than older English-only simplification datasets.
notes: Covers 27 resources in 12 languages; supports zero-shot and few-shot evaluation; includes human evaluation.
